ain.origin: official Minecraft 1.6.4; not overridden by R196 archive

mineshaft_distribution.source: agg.java:26-33; acq.java:276-281; aer.java:17-27; official ain.a(World,int,int,int,int,byte[]) offsets26-37
mineshaft_distribution.unused_field: agg.e=0.01 and chance map option are not read by the candidate method
mineshaft_distribution.source_seed_pipeline: Random(worldSeed), xMultiplier=nextLong(), zMultiplier=nextLong(); setSeed(chunkX*xMultiplier ^ chunkZ*zMultiplier ^ worldSeed); nextInt() discarded; nextFloat()<0.005F; hills; nextInt(80)<max(abs(chunkX),abs(chunkZ))
mineshaft_distribution.modern_extensions: Retain mountain-biome families and modern badlands mineshaft variants; plains, oceans, ordinary forests/deserts, rivers and underground-only biome identities do not themselves qualify.
mineshaft_distribution.random_compatibility: The pure mineshaftCandidate helper performs the full source frequency/distance stream. Modern frequency is 1.0 to avoid multiplying the 0.5% chance twice. Modern biome and structure validity still apply; same-seed old terrain parity is not claimed.

strongholds.center: world coordinate origin (0,0), not shared spawn position
strongholds.preferred_biome_scan: X ascending inside Z ascending, inclusive quart bounds; increment selection counter only on successful selection; reuse parent random before next radius
strongholds.modern_integration: Only minecraft:strongholds uses source positions; one asynchronous computation on the native background executor samples the modern BiomeSource at quart Y=0 with modern preferredBiomes; modern structure pieces and world heights are retained.
strongholds.metadata_warning: Setting modern distance=512 alone would produce the wrong 22528..43008 block ring; StrongholdDistributionMixin supplies the source formula.

preserved_modern_content: modern temple and swamp hut templates
existing underworld trial chambers and monster rooms
